title: hordeum vulgare var. deficiens
intro: Hordeum vulgare var. deficiens, commonly known as spelt, is a variety of wheat that has been cultivated for thousands of years due to its unique nutritional profile and potential health benefits. The plant is rich in fiber, protein, and various minerals, making it an excellent source of nutrients for individuals with gluten intolerance or sensitivity. The therapeutic actions of spelt include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of spelt include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and other antioxidants, which contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
